const BondAtomId = Tuple{String, Int, String}

const JSON_DIALECT = "alphafold3"

const ALPHAFOLDSERVER_JSON_DIALECT = "alphafoldserver"

function _validate_keys(actual::AbstractVector{String}, expected::AbstractVector{String})
    bad_keys = setdiff(Set(actual), Set(expected))
    if !isempty(bad_keys)
        throw(ArgumentError("Unexpected JSON keys in: $(join(sort(collect(bad_keys)), ", "))"))
    end
end

function _read_file(path::String, json_path::Union{String, Nothing})::String
    full_path = path
    if !isabspath(path)
        if json_path === nothing
            throw(ArgumentError("json_path must be specified if path is not absolute."))
        end
        full_path = abspath(joinpath(dirname(json_path), path))
    end
    
    open(full_path, "r") do f
        first_six_bytes = read(f, 6)
        seekstart(f)
        
        if length(first_six_bytes) >= 2 && first_six_bytes[1:2] == UInt8[0x1f, 0x8b]
            using CodecZlib
            return String(transcode(GzipDecompressor, read(f)))
        elseif length(first_six_bytes) >= 6 && first_six_bytes == UInt8[0xfd, 0x37, 0x7a, 0x58, 0x5a, 0x00]
            using CodecXz
            return String(transcode(XzDecompressor, read(f)))
        elseif length(first_six_bytes) >= 4 && first_six_bytes[1:4] == UInt8[0x28, 0xb5, 0x2f, 0xfd]
            using CodecZstd
            return String(transcode(ZstdDecompressor, read(f)))
        else
            return String(read(f))
        end
    end
end

struct Template

    function Template(; mmcif::String, query_to_template_map::AbstractDict{Int, Int})

struct ProteinChain
    _id::String
    _sequence::String
    _ptms::Vector{Tuple{String, Int}}
    _description::Union{String, Nothing}
    _paired_msa::Union{String, Nothing}
    _unpaired_msa::Union{String, Nothing}

    function ProteinChain(;
        id::String,
        sequence::String,
        ptms::AbstractVector{Tuple{String, Int}},
        description::Union{String, Nothing}=nothing,
        paired_msa::Union{String, Nothing}=nothing,
        unpaired_msa::Union{String, Nothing}=nothing,
        templates::Union{AbstractVector{Template}, Nothing}=nothing
    )
        if !all(isalpha, sequence)
            throw(ArgumentError("Protein must contain only letters, got \"$sequence\""))
        end
        if any(mod -> !(0 < mod[2] <= length(sequence)), ptms)
            throw(ArgumentError("Invalid protein modification index: $ptms"))
        end
        if any(mod -> startswith(mod[1], "CCD_"), ptms)
            throw(ArgumentError("Protein ptms must not contain the \"CCD_\" prefix, got $ptms"))
        end

    end

        collect(keys(json_dict)),

    )

    if haskey(json_dict, "glycans")
        throw(ArgumentError("Specifying glycans in the `$ALPHAFOLDSERVER_JSON_DIALECT` format is not supported."))
    end
    
    if haskey(json_dict, "maxTemplateDate")
        throw(ArgumentError("Specifying maxTemplateDate in the `$ALPHAFOLDSERVER_JSON_DIALECT` format is not supported, use the --max_template_date flag instead."))
    end
    
    tmplts = nothing
    if !get(json_dict, "useStructureTemplate", true)
        tmplts = Template[]
    end
    
    ptms_list = [
        (replace(mod["ptmType"], "CCD_" => ""), mod["ptmPosition"])
        for mod in get(json_dict, "modifications", [])
    ]
    
    return ProteinChain(id=seq_id, sequence=seq, ptms=ptms_list, templates=tmplts)

    end

    end

    paired_path = get(protein_dict, "pairedMsaPath", nothing)

    end

    elseif paired_path !== nothing
        paired = _read_file(paired_path, json_path)
    end
    
    raw_templates = get(protein_dict, "templates", nothing)
    tmplts = nothing

        tmplts = Template[]
        for raw_template in raw_templates
            _validate_keys(
                collect(keys(raw_template)),
                ["mmcif", "mmcifPath", "queryIndices", "templateIndices"]
            )
            mmcif_val = get(raw_template, "mmcif", nothing)

    final_id = seq_id === nothing ? protein_dict["id"] : seq_id
    return ProteinChain(
        id=final_id,
        sequence=seq,
        ptms=ptms_list,
        description=get(protein_dict, "description", nothing),

        ["id", "ccdCodes", "smiles", "description"]
    )
    if haskey(ligand_dict, "ccdCodes") && haskey(ligand_dict, "smiles")
        throw(ArgumentError("Ligand cannot have both CCD code and SMILES set at the same time, got CCD: $(ligand_dict["ccdCodes"]) and SMILES: $(ligand_dict["smiles"])"))
    end
    
    if haskey(ligand_dict, "ccdCodes")
        ccd_codes = ligand_dict["ccdCodes"]
        if !(ccd_codes isa Vector || ccd_codes isa Tuple)
            throw(ArgumentError("CCD codes must be a list of strings, got $(typeof(ccd_codes)) instead: $ccd_codes"))
        end
        final_id = seq_id === nothing ? ligand_dict["id"] : seq_id
        return Ligand(
            id=final_id,
            ccd_ids=ccd_codes,
            description=get(ligand_dict, "description", nothing)
        )
    elseif haskey(ligand_dict, "smiles")
        final_id = seq_id === nothing ? ligand_dict["id"] : seq_id
        return Ligand(
            id=final_id,
            smiles=ligand_dict["smiles"],
            description=get(ligand_dict, "description", nothing)
        )
    else
        throw(ArgumentError("Unknown ligand type: $json_dict"))
    end
end

function to_dict(lig::Ligand, seq_id::Union{String, Vector{String}, Nothing}=nothing)::Dict
    contents = Dict("id" => seq_id === nothing ? lig.id : seq_id)
    if lig.ccd_ids !== nothing
        contents["ccdCodes"] = lig.ccd_ids
    end
    if lig.smiles !== nothing
        contents["smiles"] = lig.smiles
    end
    if lig.description !== nothing
        contents["description"] = lig.description
    end
    return Dict("ligand" => contents)
end

function _sample_rng_seed()::Int
    return rand(0:2^32-1)
end

function _validate_user_ccd_keys(keys::AbstractVector{String}, component_name::String)
    mandatory_keys = (
        "_chem_comp.id",
        "_chem_comp.name",
        "_chem_comp.type",
        "_chem_comp.formula",
        "_chem_comp.mon_nstd_parent_comp_id",
        "_chem_comp.pdbx_synonyms",
        "_chem_comp.formula_weight",
        "_chem_comp_atom.comp_id",
        "_chem_comp_atom.atom_id",
        "_chem_comp_atom.type_symbol",
        "_chem_comp_atom.charge",
        "_chem_comp_atom.pdbx_model_Cartn_x_ideal",
        "_chem_comp_atom.pdbx_model_Cartn_y_ideal",
        "_chem_comp_atom.pdbx_model_Cartn_z_ideal",
        "_chem_comp_bond.atom_id_1",
        "_chem_comp_bond.atom_id_2",
        "_chem_comp_bond.value_order",
        "_chem_comp_bond.pdbx_aromatic_flag"
    )
    missing_keys = setdiff(Set(mandatory_keys), Set(keys))
    if !isempty(missing_keys)
        throw(ArgumentError("Component $component_name in the user-defined CCD is missing these keys: $missing_keys"))
    end
end

const ChainUnion = Union{ProteinChain, RnaChain, DnaChain, Ligand}

struct Input
    name::String
    chains::Vector{ChainUnion}
    rng_seeds::Vector{Int}
    bonded_atom_pairs::Union{Vector{Tuple{BondAtomId, BondAtomId}}, Nothing}
    user_ccd::Union{String, Nothing}
    
    function Input(;
        name::String,
        chains::AbstractVector{ChainUnion},
        rng_seeds::AbstractVector{Int},
        bonded_atom_pairs::Union{AbstractVector{Tuple{BondAtomId, BondAtomId}}, Nothing}=nothing,
        user_ccd::Union{String, Nothing}=nothing
    )
        if isempty(rng_seeds)
            throw(ArgumentError("Input must have at least one RNG seed."))
        end
        
        if isempty(strip(name)) || isempty(sanitised_name_internal(name))
            throw(ArgumentError("Input name must be non-empty and contain at least one valid character (letters, numbers, dots, dashes, underscores)."))
        end
        
        chain_ids = [id(c) for c in chains]
        if any(cid -> !all(isalpha, cid) || !all(isupper, cid), chain_ids)
            throw(ArgumentError("IDs must be upper case letters, got: $chain_ids"))
        end
        if length(Set(chain_ids)) != length(chain_ids)
            throw(ArgumentError("Input JSON contains sequences with duplicate IDs."))
        end
        
        _chains_converted = collect(chains)
        _rng_seeds_converted = collect(rng_seeds)
        _bonded_atom_pairs_converted = bonded_atom_pairs === nothing ? nothing : collect(bonded_atom_pairs)
        
        if user_ccd !== nothing
            for (component_name, component_cif) in parse_multi_data_cif(user_ccd)
                _validate_user_ccd_keys(collect(keys(component_cif)), component_name)
            end
        end
        
        new(name, _chains_converted, _rng_seeds_converted, _bonded_atom_pairs_converted, user_ccd)
    end
end

function protein_chains(inp::Input)::Vector{ProteinChain}
    return [chain for chain in inp.chains if chain isa ProteinChain]
end

function rna_chains(inp::Input)::Vector{RnaChain}
    return [chain for chain in inp.chains if chain isa RnaChain]
end

function dna_chains(inp::Input)::Vector{DnaChain}
    return [chain for chain in inp.chains if chain isa DnaChain]
end

function ligands(inp::Input)::Vector{Ligand}
    return [chain for chain in inp.chains if chain isa Ligand]
end

function sanitised_name_internal(name::String)::String
    spaceless_name = replace(name, " " => "_")
    allowed_chars = Set(vcat(collect('a':'z'), collect('A':'Z'), collect('0':'9'), ['_', '-', '.']))
    return join([l for l in spaceless_name if l in allowed_chars])
end

function sanitised_name(inp::Input)::String
    return sanitised_name_internal(inp.name)
end

function from_alphafoldserver_fold_job(::Type{Input}, fold_job::AbstractDict)::Input
    _validate_keys(
        collect(keys(fold_job)),
        ["name", "modelSeeds", "sequences", "dialect", "version"]
    )
    
    dialect = ""
    version = 0
    if !haskey(fold_job, "dialect") && !haskey(fold_job, "version")
        dialect = ALPHAFOLDSERVER_JSON_DIALECT
        version = ALPHAFOLDSERVER_JSON_VERSION
    elseif haskey(fold_job, "dialect") && haskey(fold_job, "version")
        dialect = fold_job["dialect"]
        version = fold_job["version"]
    else
        throw(ArgumentError("AlphaFold Server input JSON must either contain both `dialect` and `version` fields, or neither. If neither is specified, it is assumed that `dialect=\"$ALPHAFOLDSERVER_JSON_DIALECT\"` and `version=\"$ALPHAFOLDSERVER_JSON_VERSION\"`."))
    end
    
    if dialect != ALPHAFOLDSERVER_JSON_DIALECT
        throw(ArgumentError("AlphaFold Server input JSON has unsupported dialect: $dialect, expected $ALPHAFOLDSERVER_JSON_DIALECT."))
    end
    
    if version != ALPHAFOLDSERVER_JSON_VERSION
        throw(ArgumentError("AlphaFold Server input JSON has unsupported version: $version, expected $ALPHAFOLDSERVER_JSON_VERSION."))
    end
    
    chains_list = ChainUnion[]
    for sequence in fold_job["sequences"]
        if haskey(sequence, "proteinChain")
            for _ in 1:get(sequence["proteinChain"], "count", 1)
                push!(chains_list, from_alphafoldserver_dict(
                    ProteinChain,
                    sequence["proteinChain"],
                    int_id_to_str_id(length(chains_list) + 1)
                ))
            end
        elseif haskey(sequence, "rnaSequence")
            for _ in 1:get(sequence["rnaSequence"], "count", 1)
                push!(chains_list, from_alphafoldserver_dict(
                    RnaChain,
                    sequence["rnaSequence"],
                    int_id_to_str_id(length(chains_list) + 1)
                ))
            end
        elseif haskey(sequence, "dnaSequence")
            for _ in 1:get(sequence["dnaSequence"], "count", 1)
                push!(chains_list, from_alphafoldserver_dict(
                    DnaChain,
                    sequence["dnaSequence"],
                    int_id_to_str_id(length(chains_list) + 1)
                ))
            end
        elseif haskey(sequence, "ion")
            for _ in 1:get(sequence["ion"], "count", 1)
                push!(chains_list, from_alphafoldserver_dict(
                    Ligand,
                    sequence["ion"],
                    int_id_to_str_id(length(chains_list) + 1)
                ))
            end
        elseif haskey(sequence, "ligand")
            for _ in 1:get(sequence["ligand"], "count", 1)
                push!(chains_list, from_alphafoldserver_dict(
                    Ligand,
                    sequence["ligand"],
                    int_id_to_str_id(length(chains_list) + 1)
                ))
            end
        else
            throw(ArgumentError("Unknown sequence type: $sequence"))
        end
    end
    
    rng_seeds_list = Int[]
    if haskey(fold_job, "modelSeeds") && !isempty(fold_job["modelSeeds"])
        rng_seeds_list = [Int(seed) for seed in fold_job["modelSeeds"]]
    else
        rng_seeds_list = [_sample_rng_seed()]
    end
    
    return Input(name=fold_job["name"], chains=chains_list, rng_seeds=rng_seeds_list)
end

function from_json(::Type{Input}, json_str::String, json_path::Union{String, Nothing}=nothing)::Input
    using JSON
    raw_json = JSON.parse(json_str)
    
    _validate_keys(
        collect(keys(raw_json)),
        ["dialect", "version", "name", "modelSeeds", "sequences", "bondedAtomPairs", "userCCD", "userCCDPath"]
    )
    
    if !haskey(raw_json, "dialect") || !haskey(raw_json, "version")
        throw(ArgumentError("AlphaFold 3 input JSON must contain `dialect` and `version` fields."))
    end
    
    if raw_json["dialect"] != JSON_DIALECT
        throw(ArgumentError("AlphaFold 3 input JSON has unsupported dialect: $(raw_json["dialect"]), expected $JSON_DIALECT."))
    end
    
    if !(raw_json["version"] in JSON_VERSIONS)
        throw(ArgumentError("AlphaFold 3 input JSON has unsupported version: $(raw_json["version"]), expected one of $JSON_VERSIONS."))
    end
    
    if !haskey(raw_json, "sequences")
        throw(ArgumentError("AlphaFold 3 input JSON does not contain any sequences."))
    end
    
    if !haskey(raw_json, "modelSeeds") || isempty(raw_json["modelSeeds"])
        throw(ArgumentError("AlphaFold 3 input JSON must specify at least one rng seed in `modelSeeds`."))
    end
    
    sequences = raw_json["sequences"]
    
    raw_sequence_ids = [first(values(s))["id"] for s in sequences]
    if all(!isnothing, raw_sequence_ids)
        sequence_ids = []
        for sequence_id in raw_sequence_ids
            if sequence_id isa Vector
                push!(sequence_ids, sequence_id)
            else
                push!(sequence_ids, [sequence_id])
            end
        end
    else
        throw(ArgumentError("AlphaFold 3 input JSON contains sequences with unset IDs."))
    end
    
    flat_seq_ids = String[]
    for seq_ids in sequence_ids
        append!(flat_seq_ids, seq_ids)
    end
    
    chains_list = ChainUnion[]
    for (seq_ids, sequence) in zip(sequence_ids, sequences)
        if length(sequence) != 1
            throw(ArgumentError("Chain $seq_ids has more than 1 sequence."))
        end
        for seq_id in seq_ids
            if haskey(sequence, "protein")
                push!(chains_list, from_dict(ProteinChain, sequence, json_path, seq_id))
            elseif haskey(sequence, "rna")
                push!(chains_list, from_dict(RnaChain, sequence, json_path, seq_id))
            elseif haskey(sequence, "dna")
                push!(chains_list, from_dict(DnaChain, sequence, seq_id))
            elseif haskey(sequence, "ligand")
                push!(chains_list, from_dict(Ligand, sequence, seq_id))
            else
                throw(ArgumentError("Unknown sequence type: $sequence"))
            end
        end
    end
    
    smiles_ligand_ids = Set(id(c) for c in chains_list if c isa Ligand && c.smiles !== nothing)
    chain_lengths = Dict(id(chain) => length(chain) for chain in chains_list)
    bonded_atom_pairs_list = nothing
    
    if haskey(raw_json, "bondedAtomPairs")
        bonds = raw_json["bondedAtomPairs"]
        if bonds !== nothing
            bonded_atom_pairs_list = Tuple{BondAtomId, BondAtomId}[]
            for bond in bonds
                if length(bond) != 2
                    throw(ArgumentError("Bond $bond must have 2 atoms, got $(length(bond))."))
                end
                bond_beg, bond_end = bond
                if (
                    length(bond_beg) != 3 ||
                    !(bond_beg[1] isa String) ||
                    !(bond_beg[2] isa Int) ||
                    !(bond_beg[3] isa String)
                )
                    throw(ArgumentError("Atom $bond_beg in bond $bond must have 3 components: (chain_id: str, res_id: int, atom_name: str)."))
                end
                if (
                    length(bond_end) != 3 ||
                    !(bond_end[1] isa String) ||
                    !(bond_end[2] isa Int) ||
                    !(bond_end[3] isa String)
                )
                    throw(ArgumentError("Atom $bond_end in bond $bond must have 3 components: (chain_id: str, res_id: int, atom_name: str)."))
                end
                if !(bond_beg[1] in flat_seq_ids) || !(bond_end[1] in flat_seq_ids)
                    throw(ArgumentError("Invalid chain ID(s) in bond $bond"))
                end
                if (
                    !(0 < bond_beg[2] <= chain_lengths[bond_beg[1]]) ||
                    !(0 < bond_end[2] <= chain_lengths[bond_end[1]])
                )
                    throw(ArgumentError("Invalid residue ID(s) in bond $bond"))
                end
                if bond_beg[1] in smiles_ligand_ids
                    throw(ArgumentError("Bond $bond involves an unsupported SMILES ligand $(bond_beg[1])"))
                end
                if bond_end[1] in smiles_ligand_ids
                    throw(ArgumentError("Bond $bond involves an unsupported SMILES ligand $(bond_end[1])"))
                end
                push!(bonded_atom_pairs_list, (tuple(bond_beg...), tuple(bond_end...)))
            end
            
            if length(bonded_atom_pairs_list) != length(Set(bonded_atom_pairs_list))
                throw(ArgumentError("Bonds are not unique: $bonded_atom_pairs_list"))
            end
        end
    end
    
    user_ccd_val = get(raw_json, "userCCD", nothing)
    user_ccd_path = get(raw_json, "userCCDPath", nothing)
    if user_ccd_val !== nothing && user_ccd_path !== nothing
        throw(ArgumentError("Only one of userCCD/userCCDPath can be set."))
    end
    if user_ccd_val !== nothing && length(user_ccd_val) < 256 && isfile(user_ccd_val)
        throw(ArgumentError("Set the user CCD path using the \"userCCDPath\" field."))
    elseif user_ccd_path !== nothing
        user_ccd_val = _read_file(user_ccd_path, json_path)
    end
    
    return Input(
        name=raw_json["name"],
        chains=chains_list,
        rng_seeds=[Int(seed) for seed in raw_json["modelSeeds"]],
        bonded_atom_pairs=bonded_atom_pairs_list,
        user_ccd=user_ccd_val
    )
end

function from_mmcif(::Type{Input}, mmcif_str::String, ccd)::Input
    struc = from_mmcif_structure(
        mmcif_str,
        fix_mse_residues=true,
        fix_arginines=true,
        fix_unknown_dna=true,
        include_water=false,
        include_other=false,
        include_bonds=true
    )
    
    struc = generate_bioassembly(struc, nothing)
    
    sequences = chain_single_letter_sequence(struc, include_missing_residues=true)
    
    chains_list = ChainUnion[]
    for (chain_id, chain_type) in zip(struc.group_by_chain.chain_id, struc.group_by_chain.chain_type)
        seq = sequences[chain_id]
        
        if chain_type in NON_POLYMER_CHAIN_TYPES
            residues = collect(chain_res_name_sequence(struc)[chain_id])
            if all(res -> get_ccd(ccd, res) !== nothing, residues)
                push!(chains_list, Ligand(id=chain_id, ccd_ids=residues))
            elseif length(residues) == 1
                comp_name = residues[1]
                comps = struc.chemical_components_data
                if comps === nothing
                    throw(ArgumentError("Missing mmCIF chemical components data - this is required for a non-CCD ligand $comp_name defined using SMILES string."))
                end
                push!(chains_list, Ligand(id=chain_id, smiles=comps.chem_comp[comp_name].pdbx_smiles))
            else
                throw(ArgumentError("Multi-component ligand must be defined using CCD IDs, defining using SMILES is supported only for single-component ligands. Got $residues"))
            end
        else
            residues = chain_res_name_sequence(struc)[chain_id]
            fixed = chain_res_name_sequence(struc, fix_non_standard_polymer_res=true)[chain_id]
            mods = [
                (orig, i)
                for (i, (orig, fixed_res)) in enumerate(zip(residues, fixed))
                if orig != fixed_res
            ]
            
            if chain_type == PROTEIN_CHAIN
                push!(chains_list, ProteinChain(id=chain_id, sequence=seq, ptms=mods))
            elseif chain_type == RNA_CHAIN
                push!(chains_list, RnaChain(id=chain_id, sequence=seq, modifications=mods))
            elseif chain_type == DNA_CHAIN
                push!(chains_list, DnaChain(id=chain_id, sequence=seq, modifications=mods))
            end
        end
    end
    
    bonded_atom_pairs_list = Tuple{BondAtomId, BondAtomId}[]
    chain_ids_set = Set(id(c) for c in chains_list)
    for (atom_a, atom_b, _) in iter_bonds(struc)
        if atom_a["chain_id"] in chain_ids_set && atom_b["chain_id"] in chain_ids_set
            beg = (atom_a["chain_id"], Int(atom_a["res_id"]), atom_a["atom_name"])
            end_atom = (atom_b["chain_id"], Int(atom_b["res_id"]), atom_b["atom_name"])
            push!(bonded_atom_pairs_list, (beg, end_atom))
        end
    end
    
    return Input(
        name=struc.name,
        chains=chains_list,
        rng_seeds=[_sample_rng_seed()],
        bonded_atom_pairs=isempty(bonded_atom_pairs_list) ? nothing : bonded_atom_pairs_list
    )
end

function to_structure(inp::Input, ccd)
    ids = String[]
    sequences = String[]
    poly_types = String[]
    formats = []
    
    for chain in inp.chains
        push!(ids, id(chain))
        if chain isa ProteinChain
            push!(sequences, "(" * join(to_ccd_sequence(chain), ")(") * ")")
            push!(poly_types, PROTEIN_CHAIN)
            push!(formats, CCD_CODES)
        elseif chain isa RnaChain
            push!(sequences, "(" * join(to_ccd_sequence(chain), ")(") * ")")
            push!(poly_types, RNA_CHAIN)
            push!(formats, CCD_CODES)
        elseif chain isa DnaChain
            push!(sequences, "(" * join(to_ccd_sequence(chain), ")(") * ")")
            push!(poly_types, DNA_CHAIN)
            push!(formats, CCD_CODES)
        elseif chain isa Ligand
            if chain.ccd_ids !== nothing
                push!(sequences, "(" * join(chain.ccd_ids, ")(") * ")")
                if length(chain.ccd_ids) == 1
                    push!(poly_types, NON_POLYMER_CHAIN)
                else
                    push!(poly_types, BRANCHED_CHAIN)
                end
                push!(formats, CCD_CODES)
            elseif chain.smiles !== nothing
                push!(sequences, "LIG_$(chain.id):$(chain.smiles)")
                push!(poly_types, NON_POLYMER_CHAIN)
                push!(formats, LIGAND_SMILES)
            else
                throw(ArgumentError("Ligand must have one of CCD ID or SMILES set."))
            end
        end
    end
    
    bonded_pairs = Tuple{Tuple{Int, Int, String}, Tuple{Int, Int, String}}[]
    chain_indices = Dict(cid => i-1 for (i, cid) in enumerate(ids))
    if inp.bonded_atom_pairs !== nothing
        for (bond_beg, bond_end) in inp.bonded_atom_pairs
            push!(bonded_pairs, (
                (chain_indices[bond_beg[1]], bond_beg[2] - 1, bond_beg[3]),
                (chain_indices[bond_end[1]], bond_end[2] - 1, bond_end[3])
            ))
        end
    end
    
    return from_sequences_and_bonds(
        sequences=sequences,
        chain_types=poly_types,
        sequence_formats=formats,
        chain_ids=ids,
        bonded_atom_pairs=bonded_pairs,
        ccd=ccd,
        name=sanitised_name(inp),
        bond_type=COVALENT_BOND,
        release_date=nothing
    )
end

function to_json(inp::Input)::String
    using JSON
    
    deduped_chains = Dict()
    deduped_chain_ids = Dict()
    for chain in inp.chains
        h = hash_without_id(chain)
        deduped_chains[h] = chain
        if !haskey(deduped_chain_ids, h)
            deduped_chain_ids[h] = String[]
        end
        push!(deduped_chain_ids[h], id(chain))
    end
    
    sequences_list = []
    for (chain_content_hash, ids_list) in deduped_chain_ids
        chain = deduped_chains[chain_content_hash]
        seq_id = length(ids_list) > 1 ? ids_list : ids_list[1]
        push!(sequences_list, to_dict(chain, seq_id))
    end
    
    alphafold_json = JSON.json(
        Dict(
            "dialect" => JSON_DIALECT,
            "version" => JSON_VERSION,
            "name" => inp.name,
            "sequences" => sequences_list,
            "modelSeeds" => inp.rng_seeds,
            "bondedAtomPairs" => inp.bonded_atom_pairs,
            "userCCD" => inp.user_ccd
        ),
        2
    )
    
    alphafold_json = replace(alphafold_json, r"(\"(?:queryIndices|templateIndices)\": \[)([\s\n\d,]+)(\],?)"s => s -> begin
        m = match(r"(\"(?:queryIndices|templateIndices)\": \[)([\s\n\d,]+)(\],?)"s, s)
        m[1] * replace(strip(m[2]), r"\n\s+" => " ") * m[3]
    end)
    
    return alphafold_json
end

function fill_missing_fields(inp::Input)::Input
    with_missing_fields = [
        (c isa ProteinChain || c isa RnaChain) ? fill_missing_fields(c) : c
        for c in inp.chains
    ]
    return Input(
        name=inp.name,
        chains=with_missing_fields,
        rng_seeds=inp.rng_seeds,
        bonded_atom_pairs=inp.bonded_atom_pairs,
        user_ccd=inp.user_ccd
    )
end

function with_multiple_seeds(inp::Input, num_seeds::Int)::Input
    if num_seeds <= 1
        throw(ArgumentError("Number of seeds must be greater than 1."))
    end
    if length(inp.rng_seeds) != 1
        throw(ArgumentError("Input must have one rng seed to set multiple seeds."))
    end
    
    return Input(
        name=inp.name,
        chains=inp.chains,
        rng_seeds=collect(inp.rng_seeds[1]:inp.rng_seeds[1]+num_seeds-1),
        bonded_atom_pairs=inp.bonded_atom_pairs,
        user_ccd=inp.user_ccd
    )
end

function load_fold_inputs_from_path(json_path::String)::Vector{Input}
    using JSON
    
    json_str = read(json_path, String)
    raw_json = JSON.parse(json_str)
    
    if raw_json isa Vector
        @info "Loading $(length(raw_json)) fold jobs from $json_path"
        results = Input[]
        for (fold_job_idx, fold_job) in enumerate(raw_json)
            try
                push!(results, from_alphafoldserver_fold_job(Input, fold_job))
            catch e
                throw(ArgumentError("Failed to load fold job $fold_job_idx from $json_path (AlphaFold Server dialect): $e"))
            end
        end
        return results
    else
        try
            return [from_json(Input, json_str, json_path)]
        catch e
            throw(ArgumentError("Failed to load input from $json_path (AlphaFold 3 dialect): $e"))
        end
    end
end

function load_fold_inputs_from_dir(input_dir::String)::Vector{Input}
    all_inputs = Input[]
    for file_path in sort(readdir(input_dir, join=true))
        if isfile(file_path) && endswith(file_path, ".json")
            append!(all_inputs, load_fold_inputs_from_path(file_path))
        end
    end
    return all_inputs
end
